descriptions.RECEIVE WAFER LOT: Receive the incoming wafer lot, verify lot ID, process traveler, and planned product type.
descriptions.LOT IDENTIFICATION: Check lot numbering, wafer count, and route version against the manufacturing order.
descriptions.INITIAL WAFER INSPECTION: Inspect wafers for visible defects, contamination, edge chips, and handling damage.
descriptions.MEASURE THICKNESS: Measure starting wafer thickness across center and edge points to confirm incoming spec.
descriptions.MEASURE SURFACE PARTICLES: Count particles on the wafer surface using optical inspection or laser scattering.
descriptions.PRE CLEAN WAFER: Perform pre-clean to remove organic residues and loose particles before wet processing.
descriptions.RCA CLEAN 1: Apply standard alkaline clean to remove organic contamination; monitor temperature and time.
descriptions.RCA CLEAN 2: Apply acidic clean to remove metallic contamination and residues from prior steps.
descriptions.HF DIP: Perform dilute HF dip to strip native oxide and prepare a hydrogen-terminated surface.
descriptions.DRY WAFER: Dry wafers using spin/rinse/dry or N2 drying to minimize water marks and residue.
descriptions.SUBSTRATE CHECK: Verify substrate type, crystal orientation, resistivity, and batch conformance.
descriptions.EPITAXY PREP: Prepare the substrate for epitaxial growth by final clean and surface conditioning.
descriptions.EPITAXIAL DEPOSITION: Grow the epitaxial silicon layer; typical parameters include temperature, gas flow, and deposition rate.
descriptions.MEASURE EPITAXY THICKNESS: Measure epitaxial layer thickness and uniformity across wafer locations.
descriptions.MEASURE RESISTIVITY: Measure film resistivity or sheet resistance to confirm doping level and material quality.
descriptions.EPITAXY ANNEAL: Anneal the epitaxial layer to reduce defects and improve crystal quality.
descriptions.WAFER SURFACE CLEAN: Remove particles and residues before thermal oxidation and lithography.
descriptions.THERMAL OXIDATION: Grow silicon oxide thermally; track time, temperature, and target oxide thickness.
descriptions.MEASURE OXIDE THICKNESS: Verify oxide thickness and uniformity using ellipsometry or similar metrology.
descriptions.SPIN COAT PHOTORESIST: Coat photoresist on wafer surface; record spin speed, resist thickness, and coating uniformity.
descriptions.SOFT BAKE: Soft bake the resist to remove solvent and stabilize the film for exposure.
descriptions.ALIGN MASK LEVEL 1: Align the first mask to the wafer; monitor overlay error and alignment marks.
descriptions.EXPOSE LITHO LEVEL 1: Expose resist using the first lithography mask; parameters include dose and focus.
descriptions.DEVELOP PHOTORESIST: Develop exposed resist to reveal the intended pattern.
descriptions.PATTERN INSPECTION LEVEL 1: Inspect the developed pattern for defects, bridging, and CD deviations.
descriptions.OXIDE ETCH: Etch oxide in the patterned areas; control etch rate, selectivity, and endpoint.
descriptions.STRIP PHOTORESIST: Remove remaining photoresist after etch using wet or plasma strip.
descriptions.CLEAN AFTER ETCH: Clean post-etch residues and particles from the wafer surface.
descriptions.MEASURE OPENING CD: Measure critical dimension of the patterned opening to verify feature size.
descriptions.IMPLANT WELL: Implant well dopants with specified dose, energy, and tilt angle.
descriptions.PRE ANNEAL CHECK: Check wafer condition before anneal, including pattern integrity and contamination.
descriptions.DRIVE IN DIFFUSION: Drive dopants deeper into the substrate using high temperature diffusion.
descriptions.RAPID THERMAL ANNEAL: Perform rapid thermal anneal to activate dopants and repair implant damage.
descriptions.MEASURE JUNCTION DEPTH: Measure junction depth and profile to validate implant and anneal results.
descriptions.GATE OXIDE PREP: Prepare the gate area by cleaning and surface conditioning before oxide growth.
descriptions.GATE OXIDE GROWTH: Grow thin gate oxide with tight control over thickness and interface quality.
descriptions.MEASURE GATE OXIDE THICKNESS: Measure gate oxide thickness and uniformity; this is critical for device performance.
descriptions.DEPOSIT POLYSILICON: Deposit polysilicon gate material; monitor thickness and deposition uniformity.
descriptions.POLYSILICON ANNEAL: Anneal polysilicon to improve film properties and reduce stress.
descriptions.MEASURE POLY THICKNESS: Measure polysilicon thickness and verify across-wafer variation.
descriptions.ALIGN MASK LEVEL 2: Align second mask for gate patterning with overlay control.
descriptions.EXPOSE LITHO LEVEL 2: Expose the resist using the gate mask.
descriptions.POLY PATTERN INSPECTION: Inspect poly pattern for line-edge roughness, shorts, or missing features.
descriptions.POLYSILICON ETCH: Etch polysilicon using a directional etch process with endpoint control.
descriptions.STRIP RESIST: Strip resist after poly etch and prepare for subsequent processing.
descriptions.CLEAN AFTER POLY ETCH: Remove etch byproducts and residues after gate patterning.
descriptions.MEASURE GATE CD: Measure gate critical dimension and compare against target.
descriptions.IMPLANT SOURCE DRAIN: Implant source/drain dopants with dose and energy chosen for junction depth.
descriptions.LIGHT ANNEAL: Perform a short anneal to activate dopants and reduce defects.
descriptions.MEASURE SHEET RESISTANCE: Measure sheet resistance of source/drain regions to assess implant activation.
descriptions.DEPOSIT SPACER DIELECTRIC: Deposit dielectric material for spacer formation; control thickness and conformality.
descriptions.ANISOTROPIC ETCH SPACER: Etch dielectric directionally to form sidewall spacers.
descriptions.MEASURE SPACER WIDTH: Measure spacer width and profile to ensure correct device geometry.
descriptions.IMPLANT LDD: Perform lightly doped drain implant to reduce field concentration near the channel.
descriptions.MEASURE JUNCTION PROFILE: Measure junction profile to confirm dopant distribution and depth.
descriptions.DEPOSIT INTERLAYER DIELECTRIC: Deposit interlayer dielectric to isolate device layers and metal routing.
descriptions.DENSIFY DIELECTRIC: Densify dielectric by thermal treatment to improve film quality and stability.
descriptions.MEASURE FILM THICKNESS: Measure dielectric thickness across wafer center and edge.
descriptions.CMP DIELECTRIC: Perform chemical mechanical polishing to planarize the dielectric surface.
descriptions.MEASURE PLANARITY: Check surface planarity and residual topography after CMP.
descriptions.ALIGN MASK LEVEL 3: Align the via/contact mask to existing structures.
descriptions.EXPOSE LITHO LEVEL 3: Expose resist for contact opening definition.
descriptions.VIA INSPECTION: Inspect via openings for CD, alignment, and completeness.
descriptions.VIA ETCH: Etch dielectric to open contact vias down to the target layer.
descriptions.CLEAN AFTER VIA ETCH: Clean etch residues and prepare the surface for metallization.
descriptions.MEASURE VIA CD: Measure via critical dimension and verify target opening size.
descriptions.DEPOSIT BARRIER METAL: Deposit barrier layer to prevent metal diffusion and improve adhesion.
descriptions.DEPOSIT METAL SEED: Deposit thin seed layer for subsequent metal fill.
descriptions.FILL VIA METAL: Fill vias with metal, controlling void formation and coverage.
descriptions.CMP METAL: Polish excess metal and leave filled contacts flush with the surface.
descriptions.MEASURE CONTACT RESISTANCE: Measure contact resistance to confirm electrical quality of the filled vias.
descriptions.DEPOSIT METAL 1: Deposit first interconnect metal layer; monitor thickness and uniformity.
descriptions.ANNEAL METAL 1: Anneal metal layer to reduce stress and improve adhesion or grain structure.
descriptions.EXPOSE LITHO LEVEL 4: Expose resist using the metal routing mask.
descriptions.METAL PATTERN INSPECTION: Inspect the metal pattern for opens, shorts, and CD variation.
descriptions.METAL ETCH: Etch metal according to the defined routing pattern.
descriptions.CLEAN AFTER METAL ETCH: Clean residue and particles from the metal surface.
descriptions.MEASURE LINE WIDTH: Measure metal line width and spacing.
descriptions.DEPOSIT PASSIVATION: Deposit passivation layer to protect the finished device from contamination and moisture.
descriptions.CURE PASSIVATION: Cure the passivation film to stabilize its mechanical and chemical properties.
descriptions.MEASURE PASSIVATION THICKNESS: Check passivation thickness and coverage quality.
descriptions.OPEN PAD WINDOW: Open bond pad windows to expose contact areas for probing or packaging.
descriptions.PAD WINDOW LITHO: Apply and pattern resist for pad opening.
descriptions.PASSIVATION ETCH PAD OPENING: Etch passivation layer at pad sites.
descriptions.CLEAN PAD OPENING: Clean pad area to ensure low-resistance electrical access.
descriptions.MEASURE PAD OPENING: Verify pad opening dimensions and completeness.
descriptions.BACKSIDE CLEAN: Clean the wafer backside to remove particles and residues.
descriptions.BACKSIDE GRIND: Thin the wafer backside by grinding to target thickness.
descriptions.BACKSIDE ETCH CLEAN: Remove grinding damage and residues from the backside.
descriptions.BACKSIDE RINSE: Rinse backside to eliminate particles and etch byproducts.
descriptions.BACKSIDE DRY: Dry the wafer thoroughly after backside wet processing.
descriptions.BACKSIDE METALLIZATION PREP: Prepare backside for metal deposition, including surface activation.
descriptions.DEPOSIT BACKSIDE METAL: Deposit backside metal to support ohmic contact or thermal performance.
descriptions.BACKSIDE ANNEAL: Anneal backside metallization to improve adhesion and contact quality.
descriptions.MEASURE BACKSIDE CONTACT: Measure backside contact quality and sheet resistance.
descriptions.FINAL CLEAN: Perform final clean before electrical and visual inspection.
descriptions.FINAL THICKNESS MEASURE: Measure final thickness to confirm customer specification.
descriptions.FINAL GEOMETRY CHECK: Inspect wafer geometry, warp, bow, and edge exclusion.
descriptions.FINAL PARTICLE INSPECTION: Perform final particle scan before electrical testing.
descriptions.PARAMETRIC TEST: Run parametric electrical tests to verify key device characteristics.
descriptions.THRESHOLD VOLTAGE TEST: Measure threshold voltage distribution across the wafer.
descriptions.LEAKAGE TEST: Check leakage current to identify defective devices or process issues.
descriptions.SWITCHING TEST: Evaluate switching behavior under representative operating conditions.
descriptions.WAFER SORT TEST: Sort wafers based on electrical test results and binning criteria.
descriptions.YIELD ANALYSIS: Analyze yield, defect trends, and any systematic deviations.
descriptions.LOT RELEASE: Release the lot after successful processing and test completion.
descriptions.SHIP LOT: Prepare and ship the final lot to the next manufacturing stage or customer.
descriptions.IMPLANT P BODY: Implant p-type body region with controlled dose and energy.
descriptions.IMPLANT N BUFFER: Implant n-type buffer or field region for voltage support.
descriptions.DEPOSIT FIELD OXIDE: Deposit field oxide or dielectric for isolation and masking.
descriptions.DENSIFY OXIDE: Densify the oxide to improve film stability and quality.
descriptions.FIELD PATTERN INSPECTION: Inspect field or active-area pattern for defects and CDs.
descriptions.FIELD OXIDE ETCH: Etch oxide to open the defined area.
descriptions.CLEAN AFTER FIELD ETCH: Clean residues and particles from the etched surface.
descriptions.MEASURE SURFACE UNIFORMITY: Measure local surface uniformity after patterning.
descriptions.IMPLANT SOURCE REGION: Implant source/contact region dopants with defined energy and dose.
descriptions.IMPLANT DRAIN / CATHODE REGION: Implant the opposite contact region for diode or power-switch structure.
descriptions.DEPOSIT GATE OXIDE OR DIELECTRIC: Deposit a dielectric layer where needed for isolation or gate structure.
descriptions.ANNEAL DIELECTRIC: Anneal dielectric to improve film properties and reduce stress.
descriptions.MEASURE OXIDE QUALITY: Inspect dielectric quality, thickness, and defect density.
descriptions.POLYSILICON ETCH DRY: Etch polysilicon with directional dry etch.
descriptions.IMPLANT CHANNEL STOP: Implant channel-stop or termination regions to improve edge behavior.
descriptions.MEASURE DEVICE PARAMETER: Measure key device parameters after implant and anneal.
descriptions.MEASURE DIELECTRIC THICKNESS: Measure the dielectric thickness after deposition.
descriptions.CMP INTERLAYER DIELECTRIC: Polish the dielectric to achieve planarity.
descriptions.VIA ETCH THROUGH DIELECTRIC: Etch through dielectric to open contacts.
descriptions.DEPOSIT TOP METAL: Deposit top metal layer for interconnect or terminal formation.
descriptions.ANNEAL METAL: Anneal metal to improve grain structure and adhesion.
descriptions.EXPOSE LITHO LEVEL 5: Expose resist for terminal or routing pattern.
descriptions.METAL ETCH DRY: Etch metal according to the designed layout.
descriptions.MEASURE PASSIVATION QUALITY: Check thickness, coverage, and defect density of the passivation.
descriptions.ELECTRICAL PARAMETRIC TEST: Run device-level electrical tests on the completed wafer.
descriptions.BREAKDOWN VOLTAGE TEST: Test breakdown voltage to verify power robustness.
